decisions.decision: The board agreed to make listed changes to the VCD Bylaw: add the date of Town Meeting in 4.17.2; change "size" to "square footage" in 4.17.8.c.8; and reword 4.17.5.c.1 to limit one-story buildings to lots of less than five acres.
decisions.quote: the following updates/changes will be made to the vcd bylaw:

decisions.decision: No decision was made on separating the VCD and APD bylaws at this hearing; further APD discussion was needed.
decisions.quote: further discussion of the apd was needed.
